kinds.a: classical house styles · Georgian-era styles · neoclassical houses

kinds.a: Victorian house styles · 19th-century revival styles · historicist styles

notes: New view shelf (no old kinds to carry over). Five style-family kinds, 36 archetypes, ordered chronologically within each family; all archetype and kind sources are Wikipedia pages (plus Te Ara, the NZ government encyclopaedia, for the New Zealand villa) retrieved this session via web_search + web_fetch (the wiki tool returned a lock error throughout). Archetypes are maker-free style patterns (mk empty), so no brand-register entries; no craft-tradition entries, since regional house traditions belong to the sibling 'Regional house traditions' shelf. Additions beyond the plan: Beaux-Arts (grand mansions), Stick and Shingle styles (US house-hunting terms), Colonial Revival and Jugendstil (as an Art Nouveau version). Folded rather than separate: Bauhaus → version of 'Bauhaus & International Style'; Streamline Moderne → version of Art Deco; 'contemporary minimal' had no reference page so the archetype is titled 'Passivhaus & contemporary low-energy' with the Passive house page as source. Version years left vague (e.g. Mediterranean/Pueblo Revival, Federation sub-styles, Mock Tudor 'interwar') where the retrieved pages gave no dates; features in 'dt' are detail axes, not sourced claims. Getty AAT was not consulted (no AAT pages retrieved), so sources are Wikipedia-only.
